Entry.JapaneseText: あちち！ 床のあちこちからなんか漏れてんぞ！？
Entry.EnglishText: Owowow! The hell's this stuff leaking out of the floor!?

Entry.JapaneseText: <Dio>、気をつけて！ むやみにそのへん走り回ってると どんどん体力が削られちゃうよ！
Entry.EnglishText: Be careful, <Dio>! If you run around in that, you'll use up all your stamina!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Dio>さん、<Dio>さん、少々よろしいですか？
Entry.EnglishText: <Dio>. Hey, um, <Dio>. Could you spare a moment for me?

Entry.JapaneseText: 私、炎嫌いなんです、弱いんです、燃えちゃうんです。 だから、もう少し、気をつけてもらえないですかね？
Entry.EnglishText: I hate fire. I'm weak to it. Touch it, and I'll go up in flames. So, could you, please, maybe, be just a bit more careful?

Entry.JapaneseText: 気ぃつけても、通んなきゃ先進めねんだって！ 少し我慢しろよ、この書き割り野郎！
Entry.EnglishText: C'mon! Careful or not, we can't get through here without stepping in it! Toughen up, you friggin' stage prop!

Entry.JapaneseText: ぬあぁぁぁあぁ！ 人が下手に出てりゃ調子に乗って！ おら、もう許せねぇだ、絶対、こいつ許せねぇだ！！
Entry.EnglishText: Aaaargh! I try and be humble with ya, and ya go and spit in my face! That's it! I've had enough of your shit!

Entry.JapaneseText: おめぇの服だけ放り出して、ぜぇ～んぶ燃やしてやるだ。 記録も記憶も、ぜぇ～～～んぶ消し炭にしてやるだよ！
Entry.EnglishText: I'll just throw all your clothes right in there, and let 'em burn right up! All your memories'll go up in smoke!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Dio>もアルベルトさんも、やめよ、ね？ 気をつけて歩けばいいんだから
Entry.EnglishText: <Dio>, Albert, please stop this, okay? We just need to be a little more careful where we walk.

Entry.JapaneseText: あうあう！ <Mel><Mel>、<Mel><Mel>！ おらの事心配してくれてるぅ～、おらも好きだどぉ！
Entry.EnglishText: Oh me, oh my! <Mel><Mel>, <Mel><Mel>! You're worried for me, aren't ya, <Mel><Mel>? Ooh, I love you, too!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……こいつ…… サラッとすげぇ事言いやがった……
Entry.EnglishText: ...This friggin'... I can't believe he just went and *said* that...
